about_the_game:
conformer is a fast-paced 2d platforming game which pits the player against a wide variety of challenges across its 50 levels.

Every level gives you a number of points on which to spend on upgrades to help you complete the level, and do so faster. For an extra challenge, upgrades can be forgone, pitting your raw skills against the stage.

Some levels feature tight spaces where careful movements will be needed. Others will place you against a timer and force you to keep moving, and some are wide open, allowing you to go full speed ahead!

Once completed, levels maintain replayability by keeping track of completion time and enemies killed. Levels can be tried attempting to go for the most, or even fewest, or race against yourself using the game's ghost recordings system to watch your previous runs in real time as you play with them.

Once you've mastered all of the game's levels, stop by the level editor, where you can design your own!

Make easy levels, hard levels, long levels, short levels, fun levels, not fun levels then share them with friends - the choice is yours!
